subject: Re: FinCore POC — success criteria, timeline, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@fincore.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinCore POC — post call recap & next steps

Hi Alex — great to meet you and the FinCore team today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary / scope
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for FinCore’s document ingestion + customer-facing answer generation use case (latency targets + cost targets).
- Baseline model: rwd-2-small (we'll provide a recommended quantized variant if needed).

Success criteria (draft)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 400ms for 512-token requests
- Cost: < $0.0009 per generated token at expected throughput
- Quality: BLEU/ROUGE not the right measure — your business metric is NPS change on support answers; fallback is 80% acceptance rate in your QA checklist

Immediate next steps
1) I’ll share a proposed POC plan and timeline (attached).
2) Can you confirm the evaluation owner and provide a sample dataset or access point?
3) Dev team: please provision a sandbox API key and a small dedicated queue for FinCore (Dev, can you confirm ETA?)

Attachments: redwood-poc-proposal.pdf (high-level POC scope)

Proposed timeline
- Kickoff + access: this week
- 2-week data/load run: weeks 1–2
- Evaluation & tuning: week 3
- Review & decision: week 4

If that all looks good I’ll schedule a kickoff for Thursday — pls confirm who will own the evaluation on your side.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

From: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@fincore.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@fincore.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FinCore POC — post call recap & next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Good summary. Quick answers: 

- Evaluation owner: Sanjay Patel (cc'd) — he runs the ML infra team and will coordinate dataset access and benchmarks.
- Sample dataset: we'll prepare a 10k-document subset and share a secure S3 link by Wed morning.
- Success criteria: agree to the latency target and the acceptance rate metric — will convert to checklist items and share.

One ask from our side: can Redwood provide a minimal runbook for how the KV cache / batching works in the POC so our infra folks can replicate locally if needed?

I'll review the attached proposal and we'll aim for kickoff Thu or Fri.

Thanks,
Alex Reynolds
Head of Data & ML | FinCore
alex.reynolds@fincore.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@fincore.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: FinCore POC plan and kickoff — attach: redwood-poc-plan.pdf

Alex / Sanjay — attaching a short POC plan (redwood-poc-plan.pdf) with owners, timeline, and artifacts. Key highlights below and actions we need to get started: 

POC plan (high level)
- Week 0 (kickoff): access, accounts, success-criteria sign-off, baseline run plan
- Week 1–2: ingestion + baseline runs (1M tokens synthetic + 10k doc retrieval tests)
- Week 3: tuning and quantization tests (if needed)
- Week 4: joint review & recommendation

Owners
- Redwood PM / AE: Marissa Cole — POC coordination and success criteria sign-off
- Redwood Infra Eng: Dev Patel — sandbox provisioning, API keys, and monitoring hooks
- FinCore Eval Owner: Sanjay Patel — provides datasets, acceptance checklist, and final decision

Action items (please):
- Sanjay: share S3 link to sample dataset + acceptance checklist (ETA: Wed EOD)
- Dev: provision sandbox key and ephemeral dedicated queue (ETA: 24–48h)
- Rachel / Monica: I'll loop you in for weekly status calls and evaluation metrics dashboard access

Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (detailed tasks + monitoring dashboard template)

On the runbook ask — Dev, attaching a short runbook PDF separately and copying the infra ops doc link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-docs

If Thursday works for kickoff, I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute alignment.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -0700

Internal note — looping in a few quick asks to make sure we hit the kickoff: 

Dev: can you confirm sandbox API key created (label: fincore-poc-sbx) and ETA for a small dedicated queue? Please include rate limits we should present to FinCore (recommended small: 50rps burst, steady 10rps).

Rachel: can you prepare the evaluation dashboard (tracking 95p latency, median latency, token cost, and acceptance rate) and add Sanjay as a viewer?

FYI I'm scheduling kickoff Thu 02:00pm PT — will send invite once Dev confirms provisioning.

Thanks,
Marissa
